chooser.title: Welcome to Tenshu
chooser.body1: Tenshu in this browser will work for now, but to keep your data safe across browser updates and devices, you'll want sync.
chooser.body2: Everything is encrypted on this device — nobody else can read it, including us.

signupClosed.title: Tenshu isn't open yet
signupClosed.body1: We're not taking new accounts just yet — the sign-up door is closed while we finish the last of the work.
signupClosed.body2: Nothing on this device has changed. If you already use Tenshu here, you can still unlock and carry on as normal.

intro.title: How Tenshu works
intro.body1: Tenshu is built on a simple idea: your data belongs to you. When you set up Tenshu, you create a realm — a personal space where your apps live and your data syncs end-to-end encrypted across your devices.
intro.body2: Apps you install in your realm can only access what you let them. Tenshu's servers see ciphertext, not your data. If you lose your devices, a recovery code lets you start over without losing anything.

generate.title: Setting up your realm
generate.body: We're generating your realm's identity in your browser, locally. This identity never leaves your device unencrypted.

show.title: Save your recovery phrase
show.body: This is the only way to recover your realm if you lose all your devices. Write these 24 words down on paper or store them in a password manager. Don't take a screenshot — your phone's photo backup may be visible to others.
show.supportWarning: Tenshu support will never ask for your recovery phrase. If anyone — even someone claiming to be from Tenshu — asks for it, refuse.
show.walletWarning: This phrase looks similar to a Bitcoin or Ethereum wallet seed phrase, but it is not one. Don't enter it into a cryptocurrency wallet — your data won't be recovered, and the wallet can't decrypt it.

confirm.title: Let's check you saved it
confirm.body: Enter the words at these positions to confirm you wrote them down.
confirm.errorMismatch: One or more words don't match. Make sure you copied your phrase exactly, then try again.
confirm.errorTooManyMisses: That's three misses. Re-display the phrase to copy it again, then try once more.

commit.title: Setting up your realm…
commit.body: Creating your realm and registering this browser. This takes a few seconds.

commitFailed.title: Couldn't set up your realm
commitFailed.retainPhrase: Your recovery phrase is still in this tab — try again to use it.
commitFailed.networkHint: If this keeps failing, your network may be blocked. Try a different network.

deviceName.title: Name this browser
deviceName.body: You'll see this name in your device list. Pick something that helps you recognise this browser later — for example, "Work laptop — Chrome" or "iPad".

submit.title: Add this browser to your realm
submit.body: To add this browser to your realm, pair it with one of your existing devices. This keeps your data secure: even Tenshu can't add a device to your realm without your existing devices approving it.
submit.step1: Open the Tenshu app on your existing device.
submit.step2: Go to Realm Devices → Add new device.
submit.step3: Scan the QR code on that device with the camera below — or paste the pairing code.
submit.cameraHint: Camera scanning is supported in Chrome and Edge.

validation.wrongScheme: That doesn't look like a Tenshu pairing code (expected `tenshu://join?…`).
validation.missingParams: This pairing code is missing required fields. Generate a fresh one on your existing device.
validation.unknownRole: This pairing code requires a newer version of Tenshu than this page supports. Update and try again.
validation.offerRole: That's a code shown by a new device. Paste the code from your existing device instead.

error.invalidUri: We couldn't read that pairing code. Try again, or generate a fresh one on your existing device.
error.network: We couldn't reach the Tenshu relay. Check your connection and try again.

tabs.label: How do you want to pair?

offer.title: Show this code to your existing device
offer.body: This browser will join your realm once one of your existing devices scans this code and approves.
offer.step1: Open the Tenshu app on your existing device.
offer.step2: Go to Realm Devices → Add new device and choose to scan.
offer.step3: Point its camera at the code below and approve when the codes match.
offer.waiting: Waiting for your existing device to scan…
offer.validity: This code expires after 5 minutes. Leave this page open until pairing completes.
offer.pairedSasHint: Confirm this code matched the one on your existing device:

await.title: Approve on your existing device
await.body1: Your other device received the request. Look for a notification or open the Tenshu app to approve.
await.body2: Confirm this code matches on your other device:
await.mismatchHint: If the code doesn't match, deny on your existing device — someone may be trying to intercept the pairing.
await.versionHint: If the codes don't match, don't continue — make sure both devices are on the latest version of Tenshu.

paired.title: Welcome back to Tenshu
paired.body: This browser is now part of your realm. Let's set up secure unlock for next time.

denied.title: Pairing was denied
denied.body: Your existing device declined this pairing request. If you didn't expect that, try generating a fresh QR code on your existing device.

expired.title: Pairing expired
expired.body: The pairing code expires after 5 minutes. Generate a new one on your existing device and try again.

fallback.title: Set up a passphrase
fallback.body: Your browser doesn't support passkeys. Set a passphrase to unlock Tenshu — pick something you'll remember, but that no one would guess.
fallback.placeholder: (Passphrase fallback is a placeholder in this preview; the full Argon2id-derived session key flow lands with Track A.)

passkey.title: Add a passkey for this browser
passkey.body: Passkeys let you unlock Tenshu quickly using your device's biometrics or a security key. Your passkey is unique to this browser; it's not shared with your other devices.
passkey.firstEncounterNote: If your hardware doesn't support passkeys, you can skip this and use your recovery phrase to unlock instead — but unlocking will take longer each time.
passkey.saveFailedFallback: Could not save passkey. Try again.

error.cancelled: You cancelled the passkey prompt. Try again when you're ready.
error.unsupported: This browser doesn't support passkeys. You can skip and use your recovery phrase to unlock.
error.hardware: Your security device couldn't be reached. Make sure it's plugged in (or Bluetooth-paired) and try again.
error.wrongCredential: A passkey is already registered for this browser.

syncWarning.title: About browser sync
syncWarning.body1: If you use Chrome Sync, Firefox Sync, or another browser-sync feature, this browser's Tenshu data may be shared across all browsers signed into your sync account.
syncWarning.body2: When that happens, Tenshu treats those browsers as one realm device, not several. This is your choice — there are reasons to want it that way (instant access on a new machine after sync) and reasons not to (a sync-account compromise reaches your Tenshu data).
syncWarning.question: Do you want this browser to be its own realm device?
syncWarning.separate: Yes, make this its own realm device

syncOptOut.title: Exclude Tenshu from {family} sync
syncOptOut.hint: You can revisit this from the control plane's "How you're using Tenshu" panel.

chrome.step1: Open Settings → You and Google → Sync and Google services.
chrome.outcome: This excludes IndexedDB for tenshu.app from sync.

safari.intro: Safari syncs site data through iCloud. To exclude tenshu.app:
safari.step1: Open System Settings → Apple ID → iCloud.
safari.step3: Find Safari and turn off Browse with Safari — or use Private Browsing for tenshu.app, which Safari excludes from iCloud sync automatically.
safari.caveat: (Safari's options here are unfortunately less granular than other browsers'.)

syncOptOut.other: Consult your browser's settings for site-data sync. The setting you want to disable is usually called "Site settings" or "Site data" inside the browser's sync options.

explainer.title: How you can use Tenshu
explainer.body: Tenshu works on the web in three ways. You can use any combination — they all work together.

web.title: Web
web.body: First-party Tenshu apps work in any modern browser. No install needed.

extension.title: Browser extension
extension.body: Adds support for third-party Tenshu apps on websites outside tenshu.app. Available once Tenshu Rei is operational.

pwa.title: PWA install
pwa.body: Install Tenshu as an app for icon launching, offline support, and a window without browser chrome.
pwa.actionAlert: Browser PWA install prompt would fire here.

storage.title: About storage
storage.body1: Tenshu's free tier gives you {sizeGb} GB of encrypted storage on Tenshu's relay. This is enough for documents, notes, and most photos. If you fill it up, you can upgrade to a paid tier from the control plane.
storage.body2: Storage is on a Tenshu-operated server, end-to-end encrypted. Tenshu's servers store the ciphertext, but cannot read your data.

welcome.title: Welcome back, {deviceName}
welcome.body: Your Tenshu data is locked. Use your security key or device passkey to unlock.
welcome.noPasskeyHint: This browser doesn't support passkeys. Use your recovery phrase below to unlock.

unlocking.title: Waiting for your passkey…
unlocking.body: Follow the prompt in your browser to authenticate.

disconnect.title: Disconnect this browser?
disconnect.body1: This removes the Tenshu data stored on {deviceName} and returns you to the start. You'll need your passkey or 24-word recovery phrase to sign back in here.
disconnect.body2: Your data on your other devices is untouched. This browser may still appear in their device list until you remove it from there.

message.cancelled: You cancelled the unlock. Try again when you're ready.
message.wrongCredential: That security key isn't registered for this browser. Use a different one or recover via your recovery phrase.
message.hardware: Your security device couldn't be reached. Make sure it's plugged in (or Bluetooth-paired) and try again.
message.unsupported: This browser doesn't support passkeys. To unlock, use your recovery phrase on a supported browser, or switch to one.
message.masterKeyUnwrap: We verified your passkey, but couldn't restore your encryption keys for this browser. Use your recovery phrase to continue.
message.unknown: Something went wrong unlocking. Try again or use your recovery phrase.

phraseEntry.title: Use your recovery phrase
phraseEntry.body1: Enter your 24-word recovery phrase to unlock this browser. Your phrase rebuilds your encryption keys locally — nothing is sent to Tenshu's servers.
phraseEntry.body2: This takes a few seconds. The delay is what protects your phrase from brute-force guessing.
phraseEntry.placeholder: Type your 24 words, separated by spaces or newlines.
phraseEntry.hintLostAll: Lost all your devices and passkeys? Restore from your relay backup instead.

phraseProcessing.title: Unlocking…
phraseProcessing.body: This may take a few seconds.

invalidLength.title: Phrase has the wrong number of words
invalidLength.body: We expected 24 words but found {wordCount}. Check for missing or extra words.

unknownWord.title: Unknown word in your phrase
unknownWord.body: "{word}" isn't a recovery word. Check for typos and try again.

noMatch.title: Phrase doesn't match
noMatch.body: The phrase you entered isn't valid. Check for typos and try again.

wrongRealm.title: That phrase doesn't match this browser
wrongRealm.body: This browser is set up for a different Tenshu account. Check that you're entering the phrase that matches this browser, or sign out to switch accounts.

entry.title: Recover access
entry.body1: If you've lost access to all your devices and passkeys, enter your 24-word recovery phrase below to recover your realm.
entry.body2: This is a slow operation by design — it takes a few seconds to derive your master key from your recovery phrase. That delay is what protects your phrase from brute-force guessing.
entry.placeholder: Type your 24 words, separated by spaces or newlines.
entry.hint: Don't worry if you mistype — we check every word against the recovery wordlist before sending anything.

invalidLength.title: Phrase has the wrong number of words
invalidLength.body: We expected 24 words but found {wordCount}. Check for missing or extra words.

unknownWord.title: Unknown word in your phrase
unknownWord.body: "{word}" isn't a recovery word. Check for typos and try again.

noMatch.title: Phrase doesn't match
noMatch.body: The phrase you entered isn't valid. Check for typos and try again.

noBackupOnRelay.title: Couldn't find a backup
noBackupOnRelay.body: We couldn't find a backup for this recovery phrase. If you set up Tenshu recently, your backup may not have synced yet — try again in a few minutes.

kdfParametersOutOfDate.title: This recovery phrase is from an older Tenshu
kdfParametersOutOfDate.body: Recovery is still possible, but takes longer. Try again — it will take an extra few seconds this time.

deviceAlreadySetUp.title: This browser is already set up
deviceAlreadySetUp.body: This browser already belongs to a different realm. To recover another realm here, disconnect this browser first, then try again.

network.title: Network error
network.body: We couldn't reach the Tenshu relay to fetch your backup. Check your connection and try again — your recovery phrase is still in this tab so the slow part won't repeat.

mnemonicGrid.clearingNotice: Clipboard will be cleared in {seconds, plural, =1 {1 second} other {{seconds} seconds}}.

qrScanner.unsupported: Your browser doesn't support in-browser QR scanning yet. Paste the pairing code below instead.
qrScanner.denied: Camera permission denied. Allow camera access for this site, or paste the pairing code below.
qrScanner.error: Couldn't start the camera. Paste the pairing code below instead.
qrScanner.pointHint: Point at the pairing QR code

qrDisplay.renderFailed: Couldn't render the QR code. Try again.
